edits.old: Then the gap stays open and no code constant is written for it
edits.new:
Then the gap stays open and no code constant is written for it

  Scenario: AC9 Error answers 401 and 404 of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a call to POST /decode of the codec server carries no valid platform identity
    When the call reaches the codec server
    Then the response is 401 and no payload is returned
    Given a call names a path that the codec server does not provide
    When the call reaches the codec server
    Then the response is 404 and no payload is returned

  Scenario: AC10 A replayed write with the same idempotency key is applied once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write carries an idempotency key that an earlier write already used
    When the same write with the same idempotency key is sent again
    Then the replay is not applied a second time
    Then no second decision_log_entry exists for the replay

  Scenario: AC11 A retried or timed-out activity writes one entry per operation (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of the workflow fails and is retried
    When the retry or the timeout of the activity runs
    Then the operation carries one decision_log_entry and the retry adds no entry
    Then the workflow keeps the state it had before the activity was retried
